list.name: rig
list.label: Rig
list.description: Every rig that has ever logged a session -- not just the live ones, since this dashboard is for looking backwards.
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT rig_id FROM sessions ORDER BY 1

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.description: Sessions on the selected rig, newest first. __text is what the dropdown shows, __value is the session_id the panels filter on. Chained to $rig, so changing the rig repopulates this list.
list.query:
SELECT to_char(started_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')
       || '   #' || session_id AS __text,
       session_id               AS __value
  FROM sessions
 WHERE rig_id = $rig
 ORDER BY session_id DESC

list.name: from_ms
list.label: from_ms
list.description: Epoch ms of the selected session's start, minus 1 s. Feeds the 'Load session' link's from= parameter. Hidden: it is plumbing, not a control.
list.query:
SELECT (extract(epoch FROM started_at - interval '1 second') * 1000)::bigint
  FROM sessions WHERE session_id = $session

list.name: to_ms
list.label: to_ms
list.description: Epoch ms of the selected session's end, plus 1 s. Falls back to now() for a session still running, or one whose ingest was killed before it could stamp ended_at.
list.query:
SELECT (extract(epoch FROM COALESCE(ended_at, now()) + interval '1 second') * 1000)::bigint
  FROM sessions WHERE session_id = $session

list.name: total_trials
list.label: Trials in selected session
list.description: Trials in the selected session and selected time range, used to label the outcome pie's title. Gated identically to that panel's query so the number and the slices cannot disagree.
list.query: SELECT count(*) FROM events_dev WHERE type = 'OUTCOME' AND session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts)

links.title: Load selected session
links.tooltip: Snap the time range to the selected session

links.title: Live monitor
links.tooltip: Back to the live rig monitor

targets.rawSql: SELECT dev_ts AS time, value AS weight FROM samples_dev WHERE type = 'WEIGHT' AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts) ORDER BY t_us

panels.title: Lick, Reward & Outcome events
panels.description: Event rasters, each series pinned to its own y so they never overlap: lick1 1, reward1 1.5, lick2 3, reward2 3.5, and every trial outcome on one row at 5 -- 1.5 above reward2, colour-coded by outcome. The y values are constants in SQL and carry no meaning beyond keeping the rows apart. TEACH is an unanswered trial rescued with water at the correct spout. Task 5: MISS and FA share INCORRECT red; CR shares HIT green. Outcome labels remain distinct.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dev_ts AS time, 1 AS lick1 FROM events_dev WHERE type = 'LICK' AND channel = 1 AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts) ORDER BY t_us
SELECT dev_ts AS time, 3 AS lick2 FROM events_dev WHERE type = 'LICK' AND channel = 2 AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts) ORDER BY t_us
SELECT dev_ts AS time, 1.5 AS reward1 FROM events_dev WHERE type = 'REWARD' AND channel = 1 AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts) ORDER BY t_us
SELECT dev_ts AS time, 3.5 AS reward2 FROM events_dev WHERE type = 'REWARD' AND channel = 2 AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts) ORDER BY t_us

-- Outcome rows. All outcomes sit at y = 5 (reward2 + 1.5) so they read as one
-- row, told apart by colour rather than by height. channel is the OUTCOME_*
-- code from task.h: 0 hit, 1 incorrect, 2 no response, 3 abort, 4 teach, 5 miss, 6 false alarm, 7 correct rejection.
--
-- Kept as separate queries rather than one CASE, so each outcome is its
-- own Grafana series and can be given its own colour and hidden from the
-- legend independently.
SELECT dev_ts AS time, 5 AS hit FROM events_dev WHERE type = 'OUTCOME' AND channel = 0 AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts) ORDER BY t_us
SELECT dev_ts AS time, 5 AS incorrect FROM events_dev WHERE type = 'OUTCOME' AND channel = 1 AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts) ORDER BY t_us
SELECT dev_ts AS time, 5 AS "no response" FROM events_dev WHERE type = 'OUTCOME' AND channel = 2 AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts) ORDER BY t_us
SELECT dev_ts AS time, 5 AS abort FROM events_dev WHERE type = 'OUTCOME' AND channel = 3 AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts) ORDER BY t_us
SELECT dev_ts AS time, 5 AS teach FROM events_dev WHERE type = 'OUTCOME' AND channel = 4 AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts) ORDER BY t_us
SELECT dev_ts AS time, 5 AS "miss" FROM events_dev WHERE type = 'OUTCOME' AND channel = 5 AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts) ORDER BY t_us
SELECT dev_ts AS time, 5 AS "false alarm" FROM events_dev WHERE type = 'OUTCOME' AND channel = 6 AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts) ORDER BY t_us
SELECT dev_ts AS time, 5 AS "correct rejection" FROM events_dev WHERE type = 'OUTCOME' AND channel = 7 AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts) ORDER BY t_us

panels.title: Mouse position, Magnet, Buzzer and Display state
panels.description: State traces in separate bands: POSITION 0-1, MAGNET 1.5-2.5, BUZZER 3-4, DISPLAY 4.5-5.5. Display is 4.5 when the backlight is off and 5.5 when on, for both gratings and solid fills. Display type and stimulus settings remain in the database; drawing failures are plotted as backlight off.

targets.rawSql:
-- No preceding record within 30 minutes means assumed off.
-- Assumes on never lasts 30 minutes; missing logs or recording mid-state may appear off.
-- Edge points are visualization-only; recorded samples are unchanged.
WITH initial_state AS (
  SELECT COALESCE((
    SELECT value
    FROM samples_dev
    WHERE type = 'POSITION' AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session
      AND dev_ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '30 minutes'
      AND dev_ts < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    ORDER BY t_us DESC LIMIT 1
  ), 0) AS state
), window_updates AS (
  SELECT dev_ts AS time, value AS state
  FROM samples_dev
  WHERE type = 'POSITION' AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session
    AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts)
)
SELECT time, state AS position
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time, state, 0 AS edge_order
  FROM initial_state
  UNION ALL
  SELECT time, state, 1 AS edge_order FROM window_updates
  UNION ALL
  SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS time,
         COALESCE((SELECT state FROM window_updates ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1),
                  (SELECT state FROM initial_state)) AS state,
         2 AS edge_order
) AS plot
ORDER BY time, edge_order

-- No preceding record within 30 minutes means assumed off.
-- Assumes on never lasts 30 minutes; missing logs or recording mid-state may appear off.
-- Edge points are visualization-only; recorded samples are unchanged.
WITH initial_state AS (
  SELECT COALESCE((
    SELECT value + 1.5
    FROM samples_dev
    WHERE type = 'MAGNET' AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session
      AND dev_ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '30 minutes'
      AND dev_ts < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    ORDER BY t_us DESC LIMIT 1
  ), 1.5) AS state
), window_updates AS (
  SELECT dev_ts AS time, value + 1.5 AS state
  FROM samples_dev
  WHERE type = 'MAGNET' AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session
    AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts)
)
SELECT time, state AS magnet
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time, state, 0 AS edge_order
  FROM initial_state
  UNION ALL
  SELECT time, state, 1 AS edge_order FROM window_updates
  UNION ALL
  SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS time,
         COALESCE((SELECT state FROM window_updates ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1),
                  (SELECT state FROM initial_state)) AS state,
         2 AS edge_order
) AS plot
ORDER BY time, edge_order

-- No preceding record within 30 minutes means assumed off.
-- Assumes on never lasts 30 minutes; missing logs or recording mid-state may appear off.
-- Edge points are visualization-only; recorded samples are unchanged.
WITH initial_state AS (
  SELECT COALESCE((
    SELECT CASE WHEN value > 0 THEN 4 ELSE 3 END
    FROM samples_dev
    WHERE type = 'TONE' AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session
      AND dev_ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '30 minutes'
      AND dev_ts < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    ORDER BY t_us DESC LIMIT 1
  ), 3) AS state
), window_updates AS (
  SELECT dev_ts AS time, CASE WHEN value > 0 THEN 4 ELSE 3 END AS state
  FROM samples_dev
  WHERE type = 'TONE' AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session
    AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts)
)
SELECT time, state AS buzzer
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time, state, 0 AS edge_order
  FROM initial_state
  UNION ALL
  SELECT time, state, 1 AS edge_order FROM window_updates
  UNION ALL
  SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS time,
         COALESCE((SELECT state FROM window_updates ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1),
                  (SELECT state FROM initial_state)) AS state,
         2 AS edge_order
) AS plot
ORDER BY time, edge_order

-- No preceding record within 30 minutes means assumed off.
-- Assumes on never lasts 30 minutes; missing logs or recording mid-state may appear off.
-- Edge points are visualization-only; recorded samples are unchanged.
WITH initial_state AS (
  SELECT COALESCE((
    SELECT CASE WHEN value > 0 THEN 5.5 ELSE 4.5 END
    FROM samples_dev
    WHERE type = 'DISPLAY' AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session
      AND host_ts >= (SELECT started_at FROM sessions WHERE session_id = $session)
      AND host_ts <= (SELECT COALESCE(ended_at, now()) FROM sessions WHERE session_id = $session)
      AND dev_ts >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '30 minutes'
      AND dev_ts < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    ORDER BY t_us DESC LIMIT 1
  ), 4.5) AS state
), window_updates AS (
  SELECT dev_ts AS time, CASE WHEN value > 0 THEN 5.5 ELSE 4.5 END AS state
  FROM samples_dev
  WHERE type = 'DISPLAY' AND rig_id = $rig AND session_id = $session
      AND host_ts >= (SELECT started_at FROM sessions WHERE session_id = $session)
      AND host_ts <= (SELECT COALESCE(ended_at, now()) FROM sessions WHERE session_id = $session)
    AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts)
)
SELECT time, state AS display
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time, state, 0 AS edge_order
  FROM initial_state
  UNION ALL
  SELECT time, state, 1 AS edge_order FROM window_updates
  UNION ALL
  SELECT $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS time,
         COALESCE((SELECT state FROM window_updates ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1),
                  (SELECT state FROM initial_state)) AS state,
         2 AS edge_order
) AS plot
ORDER BY time, edge_order

panels.title: Cumulative rewards (selected session)
panels.description: Water delivered per spout in the selected session and selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 1) AS reward1,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 2) AS reward2
  FROM events_dev
 WHERE type = 'REWARD' AND session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts)

panels.title: Trial outcomes  --  $total_trials trials in session $session
panels.description: How the selected session's trials ended inside the selected time range. channel is the OUTCOME_* code from task.h: 0 hit, 1 incorrect, 2 no response, 3 abort, 4 teach. Task 5 adds 5 miss, 6 false alarm, 7 correct rejection; HIT and ABORT retain their existing codes. Task 5: MISS and FA share INCORRECT red; CR shares HIT green. Outcome labels remain distinct.

targets.rawSql:
WITH counts AS (
-- Count outcomes using the existing session and time filters.
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 0) AS "hit",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 1) AS "incorrect",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 2) AS "no response",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 3) AS "abort",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 4) AS "teach",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 5) AS "miss",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 6) AS "false alarm",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel = 7) AS "correct rejection"
  FROM events_dev
 WHERE type = 'OUTCOME' AND session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(dev_ts)
)
SELECT outcome.key AS outcome, outcome.value::bigint AS count
FROM counts CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(counts)) AS outcome
WHERE outcome.value::bigint > 0

panels.title: Trials per hour (selected session)
panels.description: Trials booked in each hour of the clock, for the selected session and selected time range. All 24 bins are always drawn -- generate_series supplies the hours and the LEFT JOIN zero-fills the empty ones.

targets.rawSql:
-- 24 hourly bins for the selected session and selected time range, zero-filled.
WITH bins AS (
  SELECT generate_series(0, 23) AS hr
),
trials AS (
  SELECT date_part('hour', e.dev_ts AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles')::int AS hr,
         count(*) AS n
    FROM events_dev e
   WHERE e.type = 'OUTCOME' AND e.session_id = $session AND $__timeFilter(e.dev_ts)
   GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT lpad(b.hr::text, 2, '0') || ':00' AS "hour",
       COALESCE(t.n, 0)::bigint          AS "trials"
  FROM bins b
  LEFT JOIN trials t ON t.hr = b.hr
 ORDER BY b.hr
